question: What is the procedure for securing the cover assembly after replacing the courtesy light lamp on an airplane wing?
answer: Remove Courtesy Light Lamp . Removal and Installation is typical for the left and right wing courtesy light lamps. Disconnect the electrical power from airplane. title: LANDING/TAXI LIGHTS - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the specific differences in the control switches and circuit breaker configurations for incandescent versus HID landing and taxi lights on these aircraft, considering the presence or absence of MK206-33-01?
answer: Airplanes 18280001 thru 18281503 and Airplanes T18208001 thru T18208357 not incorporating MK206-33-01 have an incandescent landing and taxi light installed. The landing and taxi lights are installed on the left wing leading edge between WS 136.00 and WS 154.00. The landing and taxi lights are controlled by two switches on the circuit panel assembly. The landing light is operated by the landing light switch and the taxi light is operated by the taxi light switch.Airplanes 18281504 and On and Airplanes T18208358 and On, and Airplanes 18280001 thru 18281503 and Airplanes T18208001 thru T18208357 incorporating MK206-33-01 have high-intensity discharge  landing and taxi lighting installed. The landing and taxi lights have an igniter installed on the back side of each light. A ballast is necessary for the operation of the HID bulbs. The ballast for the landing light HID bulb  is installed on a bracket that is attached to a wing leading-edge rib inboard of the bulb. The ballast for the taxi light HID bulb  is installed on a bracket that is attached to a wing leading-edge rib outboard of the bulb. The wiring is almost the same as the incandescent bulb installation, but there is one more cable necessary to connect the ballast to the HID bulbs. The landing and taxi light switches, and the landing and taxi light circuit breakers for the HID lighting system are the same as those for the incandescent lighting system.

question: How does the switch operation in the Model 182 control the activation and deactivation of all three courtesy lights simultaneously?
answer: Each wing is equipped with an under wing courtesy light located near the strut/wing intersection.
